WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT member.link_to_major, COUNT(*) as member_count 
  FROM member 
  GROUP BY member.link_to_major
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT SUM(member_count) as total_members 
  FROM step1
),
step3 AS (
  SELECT step1.link_to_major, 
         step1.member_count, 
         CAST(step1.member_count AS REAL) / step2.total_members as proportion
  FROM step1, step2
),
step4 AS (
  SELECT AVG(proportion) as avg_proportion 
  FROM step3
),
step5 AS (
  SELECT step3.link_to_major, 
         step3.member_count, 
         step3.proportion, 
         step3.proportion - step4.avg_proportion as exceedance
  FROM step3, step4
  WHERE step3.proportion > step4.avg_proportion
)
SELECT 
  SUM(member_count) as sum_members,
  AVG(proportion) as avg_proportion,
  AVG(exceedance) as avg_exceedance
FROM step5
